blocks.text: Built an end-to-end LLM pipeline that transforms thousands of unstructured Amazon reviews into structured product insights — themes, sentiment breakdowns, complaint clusters, feature requests, and evidence-backed recommendations. Processed 20,000+ reviews with 99% JSON validity and 98% faithfulness to source text.
Problem

Product teams often have thousands of reviews but no scalable way to convert them into decision-ready insights. Manual tagging is slow and inconsistent. Generic sentiment tools tell you whether users are positive or negative — not why, which product areas are affected, or what to prioritize.
Manual review tagging took hours and produced inconsistent taxonomies across analysts.
Off-the-shelf sentiment tools lacked product-specific structure and evidence grounding.
Large review corpora could not be processed with standard LLM context windows without chunking and aggregation strategies.
Teams needed outputs they could act on — structured data for roadmap decisions, not just summaries.
Users & Stakeholders

items.title: Product Managers
items.description: Prioritizing roadmap opportunities based on what users actually complain about or request.

items.title: Founders
items.description: Validating product-market fit signals across large unstructured datasets.

items.title: CX Teams
items.description: Identifying recurring complaint clusters to reduce support volume and improve response quality.

items.title: Growth Teams
items.description: Finding messaging opportunities from what users praise most — social proof and positioning hooks.

items.title: Marketplace Sellers
items.description: Improving listings and product quality based on structured review intelligence.

blocks.text: Product Goal
Compress hours of manual review analysis into minutes while preserving source-grounded evidence and structured outputs that can power dashboards, reports, and prioritization workflows.
Solution

An LLM-powered review intelligence pipeline with batch processing, schema-constrained generation, automated validation, and an aggregation layer for cross-batch theme synthesis. Every output is traceable to source review evidence.

items.title: Ingestion & Cleaning
items.description: Imported and normalized review datasets, deduplicated noisy inputs, and filtered low-signal entries before processing.

items.title: Chunked Batch Processing
items.description: Split large corpora into model-safe batches to handle 20,000+ reviews without context window constraints or quality degradation.

items.title: Schema-Constrained Extraction
items.description: Structured prompts with fixed JSON schemas to extract themes, sentiment, complaints, praise, and feature requests in a consistent, machine-readable format.

items.title: Automated Validation
items.description: Built JSON validity checks and faithfulness evaluations to catch hallucinated or malformed outputs before aggregation.

items.title: Theme Aggregation
items.description: Aggregated findings across batches to surface recurring themes and product opportunities at the full corpus level.

items.title: Insight Reports
items.description: Generated executive summaries with supporting review evidence — structured for product decisions, not just summarization.

blocks.text: Pipeline Workflow
Structured Output Schema
Each batch produced structured JSON conforming to a fixed schema, enabling downstream use in dashboards, product exports, and prioritization workflows without additional parsing.
Evaluation & Quality Controls
Measured JSON schema validity across all output batches — achieved 99% on evaluation sets.
Measured faithfulness by sampling generated themes and claims against source review text — achieved 98%.
Checked explicitly for hallucinated claims not supported by any source review in the batch.
Compared generated themes against manually labeled review samples to validate theme quality.
Re-ran prompts on edge cases and low-confidence batches until outputs were consistently usable.
Validated aggregation logic to ensure cross-batch themes were consistent and not duplicated.
Key Product Decisions

blocks.tradeoff: Free-form summaries are easier to generate but cannot be reused in downstream tools or dashboards.
blocks.outcome: Schema-constrained output made insights directly consumable by product workflows without additional parsing.

blocks.tradeoff: Optimizing for readable prose produces more polished outputs but harder-to-verify claims.
blocks.outcome: Prioritized grounding in source reviews — every theme and claim traceable to evidence snippets from real reviews.

blocks.tradeoff: Sentiment polarity is faster to compute but doesn't tell a PM what to build or fix.
blocks.outcome: Focused extraction on product areas, feature requests, and complaint clusters — outputs designed for roadmap prioritization.

blocks.tradeoff: Processing all reviews in one call would exceed context limits and reduce output consistency.
blocks.outcome: Chunked ingestion with a cross-batch aggregation layer handled 20,000+ reviews reliably at consistent quality.

blocks.text: Results & Impact
Processed 20,000+ Amazon product reviews end-to-end.
Achieved 99% JSON validity on evaluation sets.
Achieved 98% faithfulness to source review text.
Compressed review analysis from hours to minutes per batch run.
Turned unstructured review data into structured, roadmap-ready product intelligence with evidence grounding.
